text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning to bump v1.12.0 -> v1.13.0 tonight. Need a quick sanity check on changelog entries and the canary window. Cutoff is 23:00 UTC. Anyone blocking?
Ryan: Not blocking. Will sequence merges runtime -> infra -> console. Please don't force-merge until I tag.
Ali: FYI the quantization PR touches model loaders; I'd prefer to hold it until canary passes. Suggest a 2h canary window.
Maya: Good call. Can we run canary against the dedicated pool and watch p95 and error-rate? If stable we roll.
Sasha: I'm OOO for ~3h but can do the post-canary smoke tests. If we need to slip, we'll update #announcements with a new ETA.
Ryan: Process to confirm:
- merge order: runtime, serving, console
- bump script: `scripts/bump_version.sh minor`
- tagging: `git tag -a v1.13.0 -m "release v1.13.0" && git push --tags`
Maya: I'll draft the announcement after tags are pushed. Quick nudge to everyone: add one-line changelog entries to each PR, format: `component: short description (area)` — it's what our release notes generator expects.
Zane: Also remember the new batching default is ON in master — for canary we should flip it OFF to isolate latency changes. I'll open a tiny PR to toggle the flag.
Deploy Bot: Scheduled canary deployment for v1.13.0 at 2026-03-18T23:30:00Z to pool `canary-1` — monitors: latency.p95, error_rate, token_throughput. Alert thresholds set.
Ali: Added changelog lines and marked my PR as hold until canary green.
Maya: If canary is green by ~02:00 UTC we'll cut the main release. If issues crop up, plan is to slip to 06:00 UTC and post a slip notice in #announcements with an ETA and short blurb.
Ryan: Ping me when the PRs are merged and tags are pushed; I'll run the release checklist and kick the rollout. :thumbsup:
Sasha: ack
Maya: Thanks — I'll post a 1-hour cutoff reminder before 23:00 and the announce draft once tag is pushed.
